# 3 bed apartment for sale

> A SUPER SPACIOUS AND LIGHT FILLED GEM. June McConnell Residential are delighted to bring this EXTRA spacious and well laid out three bed apartment to the market for sale. Located on the third floor, the property is light-filled and presented in walk-in condition. Royal Canal Park apartments are sought after mainly for their excellent location but also for their generous size and finishes.
